title: Gradient spread modes + linearRGB — overflow bits in SWF and Color Mixer UI
description: Add spreadMode (extend/reflect/repeat) and linearRGB flag to LinearGradientFill and RadialGradientFill model types. Wire through SWF DefineShape4 spread bits, Color Mixer UI dropdowns, and canvas renderer gradient params. Required for accurate Flash 8 gradient parity per docs/05.
